description: This Java class defines a Fragment for an Android app that demonstrates tinting of Drawable resources. It includes UI components such as SeekBars for ARGB color components, a Spinner for blend modes, and methods to update the tint of an ImageView dynamically based on user input.

classes.name: DrawableTintingFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI controls to dynamically tint a drawable with different colors and blend modes, demonstrating programmatic tinting techniques.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, setting options menu availability.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI components, restores saved state, and applies default tint.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current UI state including selected blend mode and color components.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Computes ARGB color from SeekBar progress values.

methods.name: getTintMode
methods.description: Returns the currently selected PorterDuff blend mode.

methods.name: updateTint
methods.description: Applies the selected color and blend mode to the ImageView and updates UI labels.
